title: Finite local constancy of abelian sheaves is detected on underlying sets
statement: Let $Y$ be any scheme [def-weil-pbc-scheme-conventions] and $G$ an abelian sheaf on its small etale site [def-weil-pbc-abelian-etale-sheaves]. Let $|G|$ be its underlying sheaf of sets [def-weil-pbc-etale-sheaves]. Then $|G|$ is locally constant with finite stalks at every algebraically closed geometric point [def-weil-pbc-geometric-stalks] if and only if $G$ is locally constant as an abelian sheaf [def-constructible-locally-constant] and its stalks at every such point are finite sets. No quasi-compactness, connectedness or nonemptiness is assumed.

source.place: Definition 03RU (definition-finite-locally-constant), set and abelian clauses; Definition 03RW (definition-constructible) (1),(2). Agent-formulated finite-operation refinement.

proof.text: Forget an abelian constant-value trivialization to sets. Constant sheafification commutes with forgetting; filtered stalk colimits commute with forgetting as well, so the stalk finiteness conditions agree.

Conversely choose a set trivialization and discard empty members. A geometric stalk identifies the value of every remaining constant set with a finite set. Transport the abelian group operations of the stalk to this finite set. Each value of addition on a pair, inversion on an element, and the unit is a section of a finite constant sheaf, hence locally constant. Refine near each point so these finitely many values agree with the transported operations. The refined set trivializations are now abelian trivializations: the operations and the group laws agree. Their underlying stalks are still finite. On the empty scheme use the empty cover.

theorem finite_local_abelian_forget_iff {Y : Scheme.{u}}
    (G : Sheaf Y.smallEtaleTopology AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1}) :
    IsFiniteLocallyConstantEtaleSheafOfSets
      ((sheafCompose Y.smallEtaleTopology (CategoryTheory.forget AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G) ↔
    IsLocallyConstantSheaf G ∧
      ∀ (Ω : Type u) [Field Ω] [IsAlgClosed Ω] (s : Spec (.of Ω) ⟶ Y),
        Finite (((pointSmallEtale s).sheafFiber (A := AddCommGrpCat.{u + 1})).obj G)
